title: AtmoViz: geolocated environmental data visualization
description: Atmo Viz is a browser-based tool for exploring geolocated environmental measurements (temperature, humidity, pressure, VOC, particulate matter, air quality score) recorded along a route. It replays the route on a map with a time-travel timeline, evaluates every metric against health thresholds for four risk profiles, overlays geotagged FLIR thermal photos, and exports a PDF report. All processing happens in the browser.
